responsibility: Defines regression tests for `analyze_source_file`, verifying that source-text scanning produces the correct line-start byte positions and records multi-byte character locations across empty input, newlines, control characters, tabs, and chunk-boundary cases.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is for the low-level source-text analyzer itself, asserting the direct scan outputs—line start positions, multibyte-character entries, and non-narrow character widths—for one file’s contents. Unlike `source_map/tests.rs`, it stops before any higher-level cross-file lookup, span, snippet, or path-mapping behavior.
